checks: action transformations and unmodified task proposals
probe scope and filter gripper preservation
before/after continuity and true terminal observation lengths
compound success and failure predicates independently recomputed from all recorded positions

limitations: Hand-selected, hand-timed single-case probes; no population success claims.
Changing the safety estimator or bypassing it changes the controller; these are diagnostic controls.
Normalized command differences are not physical jerk measurements.
The target policy's learned reason for opening cannot be uniquely inferred from behavior alone.
Gripper hold prevents loss before the stall; this is not recovery from a stalled state.
All four target probes have no observed physical failure; one trailing unfiltered episode failed and is included.
Trailing unfiltered episodes follow altered target histories and are not matched causal comparators.
Video holds the successful terminal frame; no post-termination physical stability was tested.
